blocks.text: Lincoln Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

13 houses sold in Lincoln Park with a median price of $1,290,000 (the middle half sold between $1,165,000 and $1,400,000), taking a median of 34 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $576 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 6,000 square feet. 4 townhomes sold in Lincoln Park, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 12 houses and 1 condos and townhomes listed in Lincoln Park. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Lincoln Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 25% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Lincoln Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses and 1 condos and townhomes sold in Lincoln Park over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in October with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Lincoln Park compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Lincoln Park held 8.8% of the 137 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 0.5% of the 219 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 92.3% of the 13 homes listed in Lincoln Park and condos and townhomes made up 7.7%; of the 3 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Lincoln Park than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 15 in June to 12 in October 2026 (−20.0%); condos and townhomes was 2 in June and 1 in October 2026, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall.

faq.q: What did houses in Lincoln Park sell for?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Lincoln Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,290,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: The median was 34 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.9% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
